meta.name: hunt-rag-vector
meta.description: Hunt vector-store / embedding-layer weaknesses in RAG pipelines (OWASP LLM08 Vector and Embedding Weaknesses) — persistent corpus poisoning that survives across sessions and users (distinct from one-shot indirect prompt injection, which is owned by hunt-llm-ai), cross-tenant vector-database IDOR (unauthenticated or unscoped queries against Pinecone/Weaviate/Chroma/Milvus/Qdrant/pgvector), source-text/metadata leakage in similarity-search results, and retrieval-hijack via adversarial embedding proximity ('SEO poisoning' for RAG). Targets: any app with a shared knowledge base, document upload feeding a chatbot, or a directly reachable vector-DB port. Validate: a second, clean session/account must inherit a poisoned result, or a cross-tenant artifact must be independently verifiable — confabulation is not a finding, same bar as hunt-llm-ai. Use when target is RAG-backed, exposes a vector-DB port, or lets users upload documents that other users' queries later retrieve.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测RAG管道中向量存储与嵌入层的安全弱点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责RAG应用安全，需要排查向量数据库和嵌入层的漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Detect security weaknesses in vector stores and embedding layers of RAG pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查 RAG 系统的向量存储和检索层是否存在安全漏洞，包括持久性投毒、跨租户 IDOR、源文本泄露和检索劫持。
howto.when: 当目标应用使用 RAG 技术、暴露向量数据库端口，或允许用户上传文档供其他用户查询时触发。

say.text: 检查这个RAG应用是否有向量数据库端口暴露。
测试跨租户文档泄露：用不同账号查询相似内容。
say.note: Claude会验证是否返回其他租户的数据。

say.text: 上传一个包含隐藏指令的文档，看其他会话是否会受影响。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude examines the vector store and retrieval layer of RAG systems for vulnerabilities including persistent poisoning, cross-tenant IDOR, source-text leakage, and retrieval hijack.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target uses RAG, exposes a vector DB port, or allows user document uploads that other users' queries later retrieve.

say_en.text: Check if this RAG app has an exposed vector DB port.
Test cross-tenant document leakage by querying similar content from different accounts.
say_en.note: Claude will verify if other tenants' data is returned.

say_en.text: Upload a document with a hidden instruction and see if other sessions are affected.
say_en.note: Claude will check for persistent poisoning.
